name: Data Deposit Box
description_en:
Data Deposit Box provides capacity-based cloud backup across computers, mobile devices and supported NAS appliances. A single account can cover multiple devices, but backup scope differs by platform: a phone is not protected through the same file-selection process as a Windows server.

The product also distinguishes cloud-drive storage, sharing and LiveLink remote access from the backup itself. This profile focuses on selecting recoverable files, checking reports and budgeting shared capacity, without claiming an installation or restore test.
description_zh:
Data Deposit Box 按容量提供电脑、移动设备和受支持 NAS 的云备份。一个账户可覆盖多台设备，但不同平台保护范围不同，手机与 Windows 服务器并非采用同一种文件选择流程。

产品另有云盘存储、共享和 LiveLink 远程访问，需与备份本身区分。本文重点说明可恢复文件的选择、报告检查及共享容量预算，未实际安装或恢复。

sections.title_zh: 选择平台对应备份方式
sections.en:
The platform page lists native Windows/macOS/Linux clients, mobile apps and supported Synology, QNAP and ASUSTOR NAS installations. It describes iOS protection for photos and contacts, and broader Android file categories. Do not infer a full-device mobile image.

For Windows, install the client, sign in, choose folders and exclusions, and review scheduling or continuous protection. Verify that the selected files reach a recoverable version before adding more devices. A useful example is protecting a document folder on a laptop and a separate NAS share, then recovering one from each to a spare location.
sections.zh:
平台页列出 Windows／macOS／Linux 原生客户端、移动应用及受支持 Synology、QNAP、ASUSTOR NAS 安装。iOS 范围为照片和联系人，Android 文件类别更广，不能推断为完整移动设备镜像。

Windows 流程为安装、登录、选择文件夹及排除项，并检查调度或持续保护。扩展设备前先确认所选文件有可恢复版本。例如，可分别保护笔记本文件夹与 NAS 共享，再各恢复一项到备用位置。

sections.title_en: Versioned backup and live access are different
sections.title_zh: 版本备份与实时访问不同
sections.en:
Windows documentation describes file/folder restoration through the portal or device and historical versions within the retention window. LiveLink instead provides remote access to a running device through its agent; it should not be treated as proof that the same file has an independent backup. Cloud Drive stores files outside ordinary selections.

Inspect daily reports, exclusions and cleanup settings when a file is missing. Set a retention requirement and test an older version rather than relying only on current remote access. The exact retention duration, locked-file/application consistency rules and an authoritative failure runbook were not established by the pages read.
sections.zh:
Windows 文档说明可从门户或设备恢复文件／文件夹，并在保留窗口内恢复历史版本。LiveLink 则通过代理访问运行中的设备，不能据此证明同一文件已有独立备份；Cloud Drive 可保存普通选择范围以外的文件。

文件缺失时应检查日报、排除和清理设置。需明确保留需求并测试旧版本，不能只验证当前远程访问。本文所读页面未确认准确保留期限、锁定文件／应用一致性规则及权威失败处理手册。

sections.title_en: Pay for capacity, then verify the operational fit
sections.title_zh: 按容量计费并验证运维适配
sections.en:
The homepage lists USD 20 per month including 200 GB and USD 0.10 for each additional GB, with unlimited devices and a 14-day no-card trial. Its own 300-GB example totals USD 30 monthly; this is the listed capacity model, not a quote including taxes or every contract condition. Device count is not unlimited storage.

Shortlist it for multi-device file protection where the supported clients and recoverable history fit. Bare-metal rebuilding and transaction-consistent database recovery need separate confirmation. Canadian data centres are described on the Windows page, but account-specific residency, key custody, exact OS/NAS versions and legal license rights remain unverified.
sections.zh:
首页列每月 20 美元含 200 GB，超出部分每 GB 0.10 美元，可用多台设备，并有无需信用卡的 14 天试用。其 300 GB 算例为每月 30 美元，这是所列容量模式，未包含税费及全部合同条件。设备不限量不等于存储不限量。

支持的客户端和可恢复历史符合需求时，可考虑用于多设备文件保护。裸机重建及数据库事务一致性恢复需另行确认。Windows 页说明加拿大数据中心，但账户具体驻留、密钥保管、准确 OS／NAS 版本和法律许可未确认。
